messages:
maria_gonzalez: raising an escalated customer issue — prod app started getting 500s this morning. Root cause looks like structured output parsing failures after last model flip. Repro + logs below.

raj_patil: thanks — can you paste the exact request (prompt + params) and a failing model response? which model and approx time did the flip happen?

maria_gonzalez: customer id: acct_73f9, reported ~2024-11-20T09:12Z. Model: redwood/gpt-4o-compat-v2 (rolling update at 09:00Z). Request body (redacted):
```json
{"input": "Summarize order: id 12345, items...", "response_format": "json_schema", "schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id":{"type":"integer"}, "status":{"type":"string"}}, "required":["order_id","status"]}}
```
Failing model output (raw):
```
{"order_id": "12345", "status": "shipped",,}

extra debugging notes: sometimes model returns a leading summary line: "Here's the JSON:" followed by the JSON.
```

support_bot: attached logs show repeated parse failures -> upstream returned 200 but server raised a 500 when pydantic.model_validate(...) threw ValidationError. Trace excerpt:
```
pydantic.errors.ValidationError: 1 validation error for OrderSchema
order_id
  value is not a valid integer (type=type_error.integer)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 2 (char 1)
```

sophia_chen: this looks like classic schema drift + noisy text. quick fixes: 1) prompt hardening (force fenced JSON only), 2) server-side tolerant parse: try to extract the first JSON object regex /\{[\s\S]*\}/ and then json.loads with a small sanitizer that removes trailing commas, 3) return structured error to client instead of 500 (include raw_text).

oliver_kaufman: +1 on returning a structured parsing error. we should NOT let customer app blow up. propose API-level behavior: when structured parsing fails, return 200 with {"parsing_error":"...","raw_output":"...","validated":false} and a header X-Redwood-Structured: lenient. short-term patch on platform side.

raj_patil: can you paste a minimal repro sequence I can run locally? I want exact curl + headers so eng-ml can reproduce. also capture the model response with streaming turned off so we get raw text.

maria_gonzalez: curl repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-4o-compat-v2","input":"Summarize order...","response_format":"json_schema","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"integer"},"status":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array"}},"required":["order_id","status"]}}'
```
expected failing output included above.

eng-ml: assigning to @eng-ml — can we check whether the model variant introduced a new system message that adds commentary text? also verify that our runtime isn't unwrapping or concatenating multiple completion chunks which could add commas.

eng-ml: we reproduced this using the curl repro. root cause: the newer decoder occasionally emits a trailing comma when generation finishes mid-token for list/object endings; also sometimes prepends a short plaintext line.

eng-ml: mitigation plan: 1) runtime sanitizer that tries to recover by extracting the last JSON object in the response and running a small cleanup pass (strip leading non-json, remove trailing commas, ensure balanced braces). 2) add API flag structured_mode=("strict"|"lenient") and a fallback structured_response field that contains parsing_error + raw_output. 3) prompt change for affected customers: explicit fenced JSON and an instruction to "Output only valid JSON matching the schema."

sophia_chen: note for docs/SDK: add a note to client SDKs about using try/catch around model parsing and falling back to a "raw_text" field. provide example pydantic pattern that accepts Union[OrderSchema, dict] and surfaces validation errors to app.

maria_gonzalez: customer impact: their lambda was assuming validated dict -> integer math; got TypeError and bubbled to 500. told them a short-term workaround: add a safe-parse wrapper and check for parsing_error header. customer accepted temporary mitigation.

oliver_kaufman: action items: (1) eng-ml implements runtime sanitizer + unit tests (owner: @eng-ml, eta 3d) (2) platform adds structured_mode flag and response shape (owner: @eng-platform, eta 7d) (3) support updates KB + sample safe parsing code (owner: @support, eta 1d) (4) notify customer when patch rolled.

raj_patil: logging: capture one full raw response and attach to ticket INC-2024-998 so we can replay; also add last model rollout metadata.

maria_gonzalez: added to INC-2024-998. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

support_bot: closing loop: followups created INC-2024-998, PRs queued for sanitizer, flagged for postmortem in next oncall.
